primary_endpoint: Per-run fraction of distinct animals contacting an obstacle (C).
inference: Within each scenario/factor: paired mean C differences Ours-B1 and Ours-B2; 95% paired bootstrap CI; two-sided paired sign-flip Monte Carlo p, 100000 draws; Holm over 44 main comparisons. Joint completion: exact McNemar, descriptive. Seeds are the resampling units.
sensitivity: Compare frozen archive -> strict observations -> strict plus safety at exact sensing with matched evaluation seeds. No retuning on evaluation seeds.
noise: Gaussian position noise sigma per coordinate; velocities/IDs/radii remain exact or delayed. Independent robot-target position errors, fixed-shape sample-aligned RNG; same seed gives same exogenous draws across methods.
delay: Both animal/obstacle messages delayed. No controller extrapolation. Receive-relative expiry 0.30 s; safety forecast propagates tracks using measured velocity and source age.
packet_loss: IID obstacle message per robot/target and whole animal packet per robot; not correlated network outages.
blackout: Animal channel unavailable to all robots for 0.5 or 1.0 seconds every 10 seconds after t=20 s, with seeded phase; buffers expire normally. Synthetic correlated outage proxy, not geometric visual occlusion.
safety: 25 held velocity candidates, horizon 1.20 s, same robot kinematic limits, animal constant-velocity forecast; surface buffer .15 m + 2 sigma + .25*(track_age+forecast_time) m. Also checks forecast robot and obstacle proximity. No safe candidate: maximum clearance compromise. No collision-free guarantee.
limitations: Simulation only; no real animals or sensor recordings
No velocity measurement error, identity errors or clutter
Two scenes at 36:12; not full nine-scene validation
New supervisor not included in the rollout predictor
30 seeds may not resolve small differences or rare contact events
implementation_revision: R2: post-hoc avoidability diagnostic disabled in strict/safe versions because global animal IDs cannot index partial observation arrays; actual swept contact monitoring remains enabled.
discard_policy: Attempt 1 stopped for diagnostic IndexError; all partial rows and traceback retained. Entire evaluation is restarted under R2; no failed trajectory is silently omitted.
